2607.09889.title: Remembering Distinct Items, Not Tokens: A Learnable Dirichlet-Process Cache Between State-Space Models and Attention
2607.09889.paper_summary: Fixed-state sequence models compress an unbounded past into a bounded state, which caps their associative recall at roughly the state dimension; attention escapes the cap by keeping a key-value entry for every token, at quadratic compute and a cache that grows with the sequence. We study the middle ground: a sparse cache that allocates a slot only when an input is novel, so its size tracks the number of distinct items rather than the number of tokens. The allocation rule is the DP-means clustering rule, the small-variance limit of a Dirichlet-process mixture, used not as latent-variable inference but as the key-value memory operator for a deep recurrent backbone. We develop it in two forms, a static cache with a fixed concentration and a surprise-adaptive variant whose concentration follows the recent novelty rate. On a controlled associative-recall benchmark with redundancy we show that the cache matches full-attention recall while storing only the distinct items, that it dominates a fixed-budget eviction cache on the recall-versus-size frontier, and that on a state-space backbone it answers both a recall query and a long-range aggregate at the lowest memory of any model tested. The allocation is learnable end to end: a two-parameter novelty-threshold gate trained on the task loss alone recovers the rule exactly, whereas an over-parameterized gate fails, so the operative ingredient is the inductive bias rather than capacity. The evidence is a family of controlled mechanism studies at modest scale, with the distinct-items property confirmed on four real streams (recommendation, systems logs, clinical events, and insurance claims); a real-backbone, real-corpus language validation is pursued in a companion study.
2607.09889.paper_summary_zh: 固定狀態序列模型將無界的過去壓縮為有界的狀態，這限制了它們的聯想回憶大約在狀態維度；注意力通過為每個標記保留一個鍵值條目來逃避這一限制，但計算量為二次，且緩存隨序列增長。我們研究中間地帶：一個稀疏緩存，僅在輸入新穎時分配一個槽，因此其大小跟踪不同項目的數量，而不是標記的數量。分配規則是DP-means聚類規則，這是Dirichlet過程混合的低方差極限，並不是用作潛在變量推斷，而是用作深度遞歸骨幹的鍵值記憶運算符。我們以兩種形式發展它，一種是具有固定濃度的靜態緩存，另一種是驚訝自適應變體，其濃度隨最近的新穎率變化。在一個控制的聯想回憶基準測試中，我們顯示該緩存在僅存儲不同項目的情況下匹配全注意力回憶，並且在回憶與大小的邊界上優於固定預算驅逐緩存，並且在狀態空間骨幹上，它以最低的記憶回答了回憶查詢和長距離聚合，這是所有測試模型中最低的。分配是可端到端學習的：一個僅在任務損失上訓練的兩參數新穎閾值閘精確恢復了該規則，而一個過度參數化的閘則失敗，因此操作成分是歸納偏見而不是容量。證據是一系列中等規模的控制機制研究，四個真實流（推薦、系統日誌、臨床事件和保險索賠）確認了不同項目的特性；在伴隨研究中追求真實骨幹、真實語料的語言驗證。
2607.09889.author: Siddharth Pal et.al.
